prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with straight smooth long black hair, eyebrow-length bangs, a small oval face, and a pink cherry-blossom hair clip wakes in a warm bedroom; use the supplied approved-adult face reference when attached.
prompt.composition_elements: Fifteen-second daily-vlog sequence: 45-degree upper-body side close-up, slight zoom to side profile, then front-facing selfie with a plush teddy bear.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm yellow bedside-lamp light, sunlight through white curtains, plush teddy bears and bunny dolls, a slightly messy duvet, and manga books create a lazy weekend morning.

technical_specs.camera: Candid iPhone-style selfie texture with casual framing.
technical_specs.motion: Slight motion blur and grain; natural stretching, face rubbing, hair arranging, and gentle wave.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Daily vlog snapshot style with an iPhone original-camera texture, slight motion blur, candid slice-of-life framing, low-quality grain, and an authentic unpretentious feel. An adult woman with straight smooth long black hair, eyebrow-length bangs, fair hydrated skin, and a small pink cherry-blossom hair clip wakes barefoot in a warm girly bedroom. Plush teddy bears and bunny dolls are piled on the bed, the duvet is slightly messy, a warm yellow bedside lamp and manga books sit nearby, and sunlight spills through white curtains. From 0-5 seconds, use a 45-degree side upper-body close-up as she slowly stretches, rubs her eyes, yawns, and looks drowsy. From 5-10 seconds, zoom slightly as morning light reaches her profile; she arranges her bangs and turns toward the lens with a soft smile. From 10-15 seconds, she hugs a plush teddy bear, rubs her face against it, and waves gently while saying, "Good morning." Keep candid composition, slight grain, natural movement, and live-action-style photorealistic skin and lighting detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, watermark, text, logo, beauty filter, skin smoothing, AI distortion, camera shake, flicker, extra fingers, deformed, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing
